set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.1.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.2.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

set failover groups failover-group-1.explanation: The command `set failover groups [parameter1]` configures a failover group in Junos, defining redundancy and failover behavior for specific services or interfaces.

parameters.name: group-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the malfunction transfer team.

priority 120.explanation: Configure the priority of the failure transfer group.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.explanation: The higher the value, the higher the priority of the failure transfer group.

standby-address 10.1.1.10.explanation: Configure the backup address for the malfunction transfer team.

parameters.name: standby-address
parameters.explanation: Back-up address to take over traffic in case of failure.

preempt-delay minimum 20.explanation: The minimum amount of delay for the configuration of the fault transfer team.

parameters.name: minimum-delay
parameters.explanation: Minimal robbery takes place in seconds.

track interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: The command configures a failover group to monitor the status of a specified interface (`parameter2`), triggering failover if the interface goes down.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface that is tracked.

reachability.explanation: Configure the availability of the failure transfer team tracking interface.

delay-down 40.explanation: Configures the downline delay of the malfunction transfer group.

parameters.name: delay-down
parameters.explanation: Downline delay, in seconds.

set routing-table route 10.2.1.0/24.explanation: Sets a static route in the routing table where `[parameter1]` is the destination IP address and `[parameter2]` is the subnet mask prefix length.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.explanation: Target network address.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet masked bits of the target network.

parameters.name: next-hop
parameters.explanation: Next jump address.

set icmp-echo 10.2.1.1.explanation: Sets the ICMP Echo Request parameter (e.g., size, count, or interval) for testing network reachability or measuring latency in Junos OS.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.explanation: Target IP address.

interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: This command configures an ICMP echo request (ping) to be sent from the specified interface (`[parameter2]`) with the source address set to `[parameter1]`.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Sends an interface to the ICMP request.

frequency 20.explanation: This command configures an ICMP echo (ping) probe on a specified interface (`parameter2`) with a defined frequency (`parameter3`) for periodic monitoring.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.explanation: The frequency for sending ICMP requests in seconds.

timeout 10000.explanation: This command configures an ICMP echo (ping) probe on a specified interface, setting the frequency of probes and the timeout for responses.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.explanation: Waiting for a recurrence response, in milliseconds.

threshold 2.explanation: Configure ICMP response requests for network connectivity testing.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.explanation: When successive failures reach this value, the goal is considered impossible.

set failover schedule default.explanation: Sets a failover schedule for high availability (HA) clusters, specifying the time or condition (parameter1) when the backup device should take over if the primary fails.

parameters.name: schedule-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the failure transfer plan.

start-time now.explanation: Configure the start time of the failure transfer plan.

parameters.name: start-time
parameters.explanation: Start time, 'now' means start immediately.
